transcript.content: Hello, it's nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um, well, I came in because for a long time now I've just been walking around with this... flat, heavy feeling. Like, even when work is going okay or people are being nice to me, I still just feel down. Kind of empty, most days.
How long has this low mood been present continuously?

It's been... about two years and two months, I think. Yeah, it started right around the time this big dashboard project put me in the spotlight at work. It's just been pretty much continuous since then.
During this period, have you lost interest or pleasure in activities you usually enjoy?

No, not really. I mean, I still play video games with my friends on the weekends, and I still like going to the batting cages when I have time. I guess I still enjoy those things about the same as I always have. It's just... this overall heavy feeling that's always there in the background, you know? But the stuff I like doing is still fine.
During this period, how has your energy level been?

My energy has been pretty low. Um, by the afternoon, I'm usually just so wiped out. It gets to the point where even fixing a basic spreadsheet error at work or, you know, finishing up expense paperwork feels exhausting. Even trying to get myself to soccer later on... it just feels like I'm dragging my body and my brain through mud.
How has your sleep been during this period?

My sleep has actually been fine, honestly. I don't really have any trouble falling asleep or anything like that. I'm still getting my usual seven or eight hours a night. 

It's just... even with a full night's rest, I still wake up feeling pretty wiped out during the day. But the actual sleeping part hasn't been a problem.
How has your ability to concentrate been during this period?

Um, my concentration has been fine, I think. I haven't really noticed any problems with it. Even though I get really tired like I mentioned, if I actually need to sit down and focus on a report or something at work, I can still do it without losing track of what I'm doing. So yeah, no real issues there.
During this period, how have you felt about yourself—have you often felt inadequate or had low self-esteem?

Yeah, I've definitely been feeling pretty inadequate lately. Um, for example, when people at work still bring up this dashboard I built, my first thought is usually that I somehow just fooled them into thinking I'm good at my job. And then anytime I have a missed follow-up or send an email late, it just feels like... well, like proof that I'm not actually as capable as they think I am. So yeah, my self-esteem hasn't been great.
